lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios

lines.value: Under the national procedure the AEMPS assesses and authorises medicines for the Spanish market only; medicines can also be authorised through the decentralised and mutual recognition procedures.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios

lines.value: Código Nacional (CN) within the EU unique identifier

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios

lines.value: In Spain the CN must be one of the elements of the unique identifier in the 2D Data Matrix: it forms part of an NTIN product code or is added as extra data alongside a GTIN. The CN stays printed in the upper right corner of the main face of the outer pack or blue box.
